title: Versace perfume: Eros, Eros Pour Femme, Dylan Blue and Yellow Diamond compared
body:
Versace's fragrances split neatly in two: the Eros family, warm and sweet for him and bright and floral for her, and a set of fresher scents built on citrus, water and woods. Here is every Versace perfume we stock, with its notes, the sizes on offer and who each one suits.

Versace Eros: mint, apple and vanilla

Versace Eros Eau de Toilette (£68.99, 200ml) is a men's fragrance built on contrast. Mint, Italian lemon, mandarin and candied apple open it; geranium, clary sage and an amber note sit in the heart; and two cedarwoods, vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla make the base. It starts cool and sweet, then settles warm and woody. A natural pick for nights out, parties and the colder months.

Versace Eros Parfum

Versace Eros Parfum (from £68.99, 100ml or 200ml) is the darker, more resinous version. Italian lemon, mandarin, litsea cubeba, elemi and black pepper open it; pomarose, Egyptian geranium, lavender and clary sage form the heart; and benzoin, cashmeran, patchouli, vanilla and vetiver sit underneath. Where the eau de toilette leans on mint and apple, the parfum leans on pepper, lavender and resin.

Eros eau de toilette or Eros Parfum? Choose the eau de toilette if you like the minty, sweet apple opening; choose the parfum for a spicier, deeper scent. A parfum holds a higher share of fragrance oils than an eau de toilette, so it feels richer and sits closer to the skin. Our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.

Versace Eros Pour Femme

Eros Pour Femme is a different perfume from the men's Eros, not a softer version of it. It comes in two strengths with different notes:

  • Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum (£59.99, 100ml): Sicilian lemon, Calabrian bergamot and pomegranate, then lemon flower, jasmine sambac and peony, over sandalwood, amber and musk. Bright at first, then floral and polished.
  • Eros Pour Femme Eau de Toilette Miniature (£13.99, 5ml): Sicilian lemon, mandarin, raspberry sorbet and white currant, then freesia, magnolia, jasmine petals and orange blossom, over ambrox, white patchouli and musk. Juicier and lighter, an easy daytime scent.

Versace Dylan Blue Pour Homme

Versace Dylan Blue Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Miniature (£13.99, 5ml) opens with water notes, fig leaves, bergamot and grapefruit. Violet leaves, patchouli, papyrus, black pepper and ambroxan sit in the heart, with musk, tonka bean, saffron and frankincense underneath. It starts fresh and aquatic and dries down darker and woodier, so it works for the day and for evenings.

Versace Man Eau Fraîche

Versace Man Eau Fraîche Eau de Toilette Miniature (£13.99, 5ml) is the crispest Versace for men: white lemon, rosewood and star fruit, then tarragon, cedar leaves and clary sage, over musk, amber and sycamore wood. Clean and airy, it suits hot days, holidays and the gym bag.

Versace Yellow Diamond

Versace Yellow Diamond Eau de Toilette (£52.99, 90ml) is a sunny floral for women. Citron, pear sorbet, neroli and bergamot open it; water lily, freesia, orange blossom and mimosa form a soft heart; and amber wood, palo santo and musk sit quietly underneath. Light, fruity and slightly powdery, it is a spring and summer scent, and an easy one for the office.

Which Versace perfume should you choose?

  • A sweet, warm scent for him: Versace Eros Eau de Toilette.
  • A deeper, spicier version: Versace Eros Parfum.
  • A fresh scent that turns woody: Dylan Blue Pour Homme.
  • Something light and citrusy for him: Man Eau Fraîche.
  • A bright floral for her: Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum, or the eau de toilette for a fruitier, lighter take.
  • A soft, sunny floral for her: Yellow Diamond.
  • Not sure yet: start with a 5ml miniature at £13.99.

If you like the fresh, marine side of Dylan Blue, Paco Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette (£78.99, 200ml) has sea notes and grapefruit over guaiac wood and patchouli. It is a different perfume, not a copy; our Paco Rabanne guide compares the whole range.

Good to know

  • The 5ml miniatures make easy stocking fillers: see our mini perfume sets guide for more.
  • Buying a gift? Our perfume gift sets guide has more Christmas ideas.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.
